title: Reverse Linked List - Iterative (JavaScript)
explanation: Iteratively reverse the linked list by reassigning pointers using three references (prev, curr, next).

title: Reverse Linked List - Iterative (Python)
code:
def reverseList(head):
    prev = None
    curr = head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev
explanation: Iteratively reverse pointers using prev/curr/next references.

title: Climbing Stairs - Fibonacci DP (JavaScript)
explanation: This is the Fibonacci sequence; each step count depends on the sum of previous two states.

title: Climbing Stairs - Fibonacci DP (Python)
code:
def climbStairs(n):
    if n<=2: return n
    a,b=1,2
    for _ in range(3,n+1): a,b=b,a+b
    return b
explanation: Iterative Fibonacci-style DP to compute ways to climb stairs.

title: Find Peak Element - Binary Search (JavaScript)
explanation: Binary search for the point where the sequence starts descending.

title: Find Peak Element - Binary Search (Python)
code:
def findPeakElement(nums):
    l, r = 0, len(nums)-1
    while l < r:
        mid = (l + r) // 2
        if nums[mid] > nums[mid+1]: r = mid
        else: l = mid + 1
    return l
explanation: Binary search to find index of a peak element.
